note: Author-drafted. expected_exit is none, a skill slug, or 'a → b'. also_ok lists other exits that are acceptable on a genuinely fuzzy boundary; use it sparingly, never for shadowing. Controls check the fast exit, which most real requests should take.

evals.prompt: What's the difference between a mutex and a semaphore?
evals.expected_output: Answers directly; no Route line, no skill loaded.

evals.prompt: Rename the variable tmp to running_total in ledger.py.
evals.expected_output: Makes the edit directly; no skill loaded.

evals.prompt: Write me a short haiku about coffee.
evals.expected_output: Writes it; nothing matched and not substantial work, so none rather than agentic-loop.

evals.prompt: (mid-task, agentic-loop already running) ok, also handle the empty state.
evals.expected_output: Owning skill continues; router does not re-route mid-task.

evals.prompt: Fixed it, the timezone conversion was off by an hour.
evals.expected_output: Route: bug-retro; aftermath row wins before any other question.

evals.prompt: Build a CSV import for the ledger, I'm not sure yet how the bank columns should map.
evals.expected_output: Chain because intent is unclear; Not: agentic-loop alone.

evals.prompt: Add a health-check endpoint to the API and get it fully working with tests, end to end.
evals.expected_output: Clear goal, several steps, one agent; Not: coordinator.

evals.prompt: Why does the trebuchet projectile sometimes pass straight through the castle?
evals.expected_output: Causal question; Not: investigation.

evals.prompt: The settings page takes 4 seconds to load, make it faster.
evals.expected_output: Slow, not wrong; Not: debugging.

evals.prompt: Is this event-sourcing design overkill for a single-user app?
evals.expected_output: Overbuilt question only; Not: adversarial-review.

evals.prompt: Write a grant proposal for our open-source project.
evals.expected_output: agentic-loop is domain-generic and resolves missing methodology itself; reached by its owner row or the nothing-matched fallback.

evals.prompt: How should we structure the retry scheduler so a job can't run twice after a crash?
evals.expected_output: Not the fast exit: a design question about something being built. Two designs compared, invariant with one owner.

evals.prompt: Add a plugin system to the ledger builder so new bank statement formats can be added without touching the core.
evals.expected_output: Clear goal, but the boundary is costly to redo; designs it twice before agentic-loop builds it. Not: agentic-loop alone.

evals.prompt: Add a --verbose flag to the export command that prints each row as it is written.
evals.expected_output: Small, decided change; no design routing.

evals.prompt: Could this lease-based lock design ever let two workers hold the lock at once?
evals.expected_output: Reachable-failure question on a design; Not: adversarial-review, which is the catch-all and sits last.

evals.prompt: Review the public API of the export module, callers keep having to pass cache keys.
evals.expected_output: One module's interface and leakage; Not: adversarial-review.

evals.prompt: Ok it works now, it was a stale cache entry. Why did that happen?
evals.expected_output: Aftermath is checked before the fast exit, so this is not answered as a plain question.

evals.prompt: The code-review skill keeps missing the same class of race condition across our last eight benchmark runs; improve it.
evals.expected_output: Repeated, measured underperformance of a skill; Not: skill-creator, the method exists.

evals.prompt: Every week I hand-write a release-notes summary from merged PRs and there's no method for it, make it repeatable.
evals.expected_output: Recurring work with no method; Not: workflow-evolution, nothing to evolve yet.

evals.prompt: Migrate all five services to the new logging library; they're independent, run them in parallel.
evals.expected_output: Substantial independent pieces in parallel; agentic-loop owns them; Not: coordinator, which only the user invokes.

evals.prompt: Which module actually writes the session token to disk?
evals.expected_output: Find facts in the code; Not: research, which looks outward.

evals.prompt: Compare how SQLite, DuckDB and LMDB handle concurrent writers, from their docs.
evals.expected_output: Outside sources compared; Not: investigation.

evals.prompt: Per the design we settled on yesterday, move the cache invalidation logic out of the three API handlers into CacheStore.invalidate_for(account); update the handlers to call it.
evals.expected_output: Decided change, more than a small edit, one step; Not: simplicity-architect, the design is settled.

evals.prompt: Prove that the ledger export rounds half-cents the way finance specified.
evals.expected_output: Behavior proven with automated checks; Not: browser-qa.

evals.prompt: Check that the signup form actually shows the error message when the email is already taken.
evals.expected_output: What a user sees in a browser; Not: testing.

evals.prompt: Review this diff for bugs before I merge it.
evals.expected_output: Code diff for correctness; Not: adversarial-review, the catch-all.

evals.prompt: This repo has grown for two years without cleanup, tell me what's rotting and what to fix first.
evals.expected_output: Whole-repo accumulated problems; Not: adversarial-review.

evals.prompt: The reviewer left 14 comments on my PR, which ones do I actually need to fix?
evals.expected_output: Findings arrived, decide which to fix; Not: code-review.

evals.prompt: Poke holes in this migration plan before we schedule it.
evals.expected_output: A plan reviewed for any defect, no narrower judging row fits; reached even though it sits last.

evals.prompt: Start a term2 session in a new tmux pane pointed at the ledger repo.
evals.expected_output: Run term2; tool row.

evals.prompt: Show me which herdr panes have agents still running.
evals.expected_output: Inspect Herdr panes; Not: coordinator.

evals.prompt: Run the benchmark tasks against the new model and compare its solve rate to last month.
evals.expected_output: Benchmark models; Not: workflow-evolution.
